title: Onboarding snapshot pack: optimizer microcopy, guided screenshots, and CLI hints (Optimize toolkit)
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Summary:
Create a compact, production-ready pack of onboarding visuals and microcopy that will live in the Optimize toolkit quickstart and the Console release notes. The pack will cover three core flows: batching recommendations, prefix/KV caching hints, and quantization profile selection. Visual assets should include desktop screenshots, a 3-frame GIF for the first-run flow, and a stripped-down mobile snapshot. Also produce small CLI/SDK snippet screenshots showing how to apply recommended settings via API and SDK.

Goals:
- Reduce time-to-value for new users who land on Optimize -> Recommendations.
- Communicate trade-offs (latency vs cost vs quality) in one glance.
- Provide assets that engineers can drop into docs, product release notes, and onboarding emails.

Target audience:
- ML engineers evaluating the Optimize toolkit for their inference workloads.
- Frontend/product engineers integrating Optimize quickstart.

Deliverables (finals):
- PNG screenshot set: desktop (3 variants: default, applied-batching, applied-quantization)
- Mobile snapshot: 1 PNG (compact layout)
- GIF: 3-frame first-run walkthrough demonstrating recommendations being applied and the small impact chart updating
- 2 small code-snippet screenshots: SDK call and CLI flag to enable suggested profile
- Microcopy file: 6 short text lines for in-product tooltips and a longer 150-word explanatory blurb for docs
- Figma file with annotated components and responsive variants

Constraints and non-goals:
- This ticket does not include localization translations (we'll hand off copy to Content for l10n).
- No new UX patterns or flows; assets must use existing Console layouts and style tokens.

Design decisions and notes:
- Use the new compact card layout (Console tokens) for all screenshots to keep visual density low.
- Highlight the recommended action with a 3-step badge: "Save CPU", "Keep Quality", "Lower Cost" (icons only). PM requested neutral wording that avoids absolutes.
- For quantization, show two small comparative rows: float16 vs 8-bit quantized with relative token cost badges. Do not show absolute numbers in screenshots; use relative sparklines to avoid commitment to exact cost figures.
- GIF should be loopable and no longer than 4s. Keep file sizes <= 1.2MB.

Accessibility and localization notes:
- All microcopy must stay within 70 characters for tooltip elements; 150 characters max for inline helper text.
- Provide alt text for every image (see acceptance criteria).

Analytics and instrumentation:
- Add tracking annotations in the Figma file for the following CTAs: "Apply recommendation", "View details", "Open quant profiles". Map to analytics events: optimize.onboard.apply, optimize.onboard.view_details, optimize.onboard.open_profiles. Engineering will implement once assets are accepted.

Handoff checklist:
- Figma file link and exported PNG/GIFs uploaded to Drive folder -> Drive link below.
- Add microcopy to docs draft in Confluence and ping Content for l10n.
- Create a small PR with screenshots for the release notes.
acceptance_criteria: Three desktop PNG variants exported at @1x and @2x and uploaded to Drive
One mobile PNG exported and responsive annotations added to Figma
Looping GIF demonstrates 3-step first-run flow and is <= 1.2MB
Two code-snippet screenshots match current SDK/CLI style and contain no sensitive tokens
Microcopy file contains 6 tooltip strings and a 150-word docs blurb, with alt-text for each image
Figma file contains annotated components, tracking mappings, and export-ready slices
PM and Eng have given design review approval in comments
